blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Sec. Jonvic Remulla on Wednesday said the rising value of illegal drugs resulted in a decline of supply in the country due to the government’s continued anti-drug operations. According to Remulla, the cost of “shabu” (crystal meth) was around P3,800 per gram in the previous administration, which is significantly lower than its current value of P6,800 per gram. “Ibig sabihin ang supply ang mababa, nahihirapan sila ang kumuha,” he said during a briefing at a port in Manila.
